items.maidspell:anchor_core.desc2: Continuously force-loads the chunk the maid is in
items.maidspell:anchor_core.desc3: Intercepts abnormal save / saveWithoutId / remove calls that could duplicate or delete the maid
items.maidspell:anchor_core.desc4: Blocks entity conversion and some external capture mechanics; prevents loot drops while the maid still has health
items.maidspell:anchor_core.desc5: Anchored to this world, never to fade
items.maidspell:bleeding_heart.desc2: Converts %s%% of damage dealt to enemies into health
items.maidspell:bleeding_heart.desc3: Heals both the maid and master
items.maidspell:blue_note.desc1: Right-click to open the spell collection interface
items.maidspell:blue_note.desc2: Used to mark spells from Iron's Spells
items.maidspell:blue_note.desc3: Marked spells will be cast on the master
items.maidspell:chaos_book.desc2: Converts the original hit into %s separate damage instances, each dealing at least %s damage, and resets the target's invulnerability frames
items.maidspell:chaos_book.desc3: Each hit also deals extra true damage equal to %s%% of the target's max health (minimum %s)
items.maidspell:double_heart_chain.desc2: Maid and master share damage taken
items.maidspell:ender_pocket.desc1: A mysterious pouch connecting to ender space
items.maidspell:ender_pocket.desc2: Allows remote access to maid backpacks
items.maidspell:ender_pocket.desc3: Press bind key to open maid selection interface
items.maidspell:far_task_icon.desc: Icon for ranged spell combat task
items.maidspell:floating_fox_leaf.desc1: A lotus leaf bearing a little fox over the ripples.
items.maidspell:floating_fox_leaf.desc2: Lets the maid walk on water and greatly reduces sinking on the surface
items.maidspell:floating_fox_leaf.desc3: Falls back to normal swimming once the maid is fully underwater
items.maidspell:floating_fox_leaf.desc4: The owner also shares water walking within range; sneak or fully submerge to disable it
items.maidspell:flow_core.desc2: Heals once every %ss for (%s%% * favorability level * max health)
items.maidspell:flow_core.desc3: Reduces final damage taken by (%s%% * favorability level)
items.maidspell:fragrant_ingenuity.desc1: A carefully woven satchel, carrying a sweet fragrance
items.maidspell:fragrant_ingenuity.desc2: Maid gains +%s favorability when eating food
items.maidspell:fragrant_ingenuity.desc3: When the maid feeds the master, grants 1 random beneficial effect for %ss
items.maidspell:fragrant_ingenuity.desc4: With Dreamcloud Crystal, this becomes 2 different effects at level 2-10 for 120-240 seconds
items.maidspell:hairpin.desc1: Two families united in marriage, bound by vows
items.maidspell:hairpin.desc2: Maid's damage is reduced by master's defense calculations before being applied
items.maidspell:hairpin.desc4: Favorability Level 3: Immune to negative effects
items.maidspell:hairpin.desc5: Maid gains +%s favorability when eating food
items.maidspell:jingxu_youlan.desc1: An orchid of the pure ruins, cleansing all impurities
items.maidspell:jingxu_youlan.desc2: Periodically removes harmful effects from maids within 3 blocks
items.maidspell:jingxu_youlan.desc3: Removes all potion effects from other living beings within 3 blocks
items.maidspell:melee_task_icon.desc: Icon for melee spell combat task
items.maidspell:molten_fox_leaf.desc1: A molten leaf bearing a fox spirit through blazing lava.
items.maidspell:molten_fox_leaf.desc2: Lets the maid walk on lava and stay balanced on the surface
items.maidspell:molten_fox_leaf.desc3: Grants immunity to fire, burning, hot floor, and lava damage
items.maidspell:molten_fox_leaf.desc4: The owner also shares lava walking and fire protection within range; sneak or fully submerge to disable it
items.maidspell:quick_chant_ring.desc2: Reduces spell cooldown by %s%% per maid favorability level
items.maidspell:rock_crystal.desc1: A magical crystal solid as bedrock
items.maidspell:scarlet_zhuhua.desc1: A scarlet flower that blooms on crimson nylium
items.maidspell:scarlet_zhuhua.desc2: Periodically grants Strength to nearby living beings within 3 blocks
items.maidspell:scarlet_zhuhua.desc3: Inflicts Wither on non-maid, non-corrupted-knight entities
items.maidspell:sliver_cercis.desc2: After the maid is hurt %s times, or if more than %s ticks passed since the last trigger, deals true damage equal to %s%% of that hit to the most recent attacker
items.maidspell:sliver_cercis.desc4: With Dreamcloud Crystal, this triggers on every hit taken and the retaliation multiplier is doubled
items.maidspell:soul_book.desc2: Maid cannot take damage exceeding %s%% of maximum health
items.maidspell:soul_book.desc3: If the next hit arrives within %ss of the previous one, that damage is canceled entirely
items.maidspell:soul_book.desc4: Also intercepts abnormal damage-resolution paths for both players and maids
items.maidspell:spell_enhancement_core.desc2: Copies the master's Iron's Spellbooks attributes that are above their default values
items.maidspell:spell_enhancement_core.desc3: Refreshes every 2 seconds and only works when Iron's Spellbooks is installed
items.maidspell:spell_overlimit_core.desc2: Allows spell books that would normally be mutually exclusive because of same-type or inheritance checks to coexist
items.maidspell:spell_overlimit_core.desc3: Without it, only one book from the same type hierarchy can be kept; equipping it removes that restriction
items.maidspell:spring_bloom_return.desc1: Spring winds linger, fallen petals return
items.maidspell:spring_bloom_return.desc2: After casting any spell, gain 1 Bloom Return stack, up to %s, lasting %s seconds
items.maidspell:spring_bloom_return.desc3: Triggers when the maid or master takes at least %s damage, or %s%% of max health
items.maidspell:spring_bloom_return.desc4: Consumes 1 stack: restores life equal to %s%% max health and refunds %s%% remaining spell cooldown
items.maidspell:spring_bloom_return.desc5: At Favorability Level 3, also removes 1 negative effect
items.maidspell:spring_ring.desc2: Increases damage by same percentage as maid's lost health percentage
items.maidspell:wound_rime_blade.desc2: Records the lowest health of struck enemies and prevents later healing from exceeding that value
items.maidspell:wound_rime_blade.desc3: The wounds it creates never heal
items.maidspell:wound_rime_blade.desc4: Only works on non-player, non-maid targets; repeated hits stack the suppression record
items.maidspell:yue_linglan.desc1: Lily bells sway, seeking traces of the elves
items.maidspell:yue_linglan.desc2: Periodically grants Regeneration and Resistance to maids within 3 blocks
items.maidspell:yue_linglan.desc3: Emits guiding dust towards the Elven Realm
